vars.panel_description: a dialogue choice interface: a wide lower dialogue field and three evenly spaced thin choice bays above it, with ink-brush corner decoration

prompt:
90 年代中国港式武侠漫画美术风格，2.5D 漫画质感，
墨线分明清晰，厚涂上色、色彩饱和鲜艳明亮，
人物五官立体，衣袂飘动有动势，
整体明亮通透、光影对比鲜明、阳光感强、色彩活力充沛，
保持暖色调与冷色调的鲜明对比，避免整体灰暗压抑。

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: a single reusable 2D wuxia RPG system UI panel background for Godot.
Primary request: a dialogue choice interface: a wide lower dialogue field and three evenly spaced thin choice bays above it, with ink-brush corner decoration.
Composition: landscape 3:2 presentation, centered framed panel with a clearly calm inset content area, generous safe margins, ornamental borders concentrated at corners and edges. The center and content regions must remain quiet and low-contrast for live Godot controls, lists, labels and icons to be drawn on top.
Materials/textures: matte blue-black forged iron, restrained cold steel trim, subtle teal jade inlay, aged ink-brush ornamental line work, very small dark crimson accents only where appropriate.
Lighting/mood: readable, bright enough for gameplay, crisp cold highlights, no murky black crush.
Constraints: no characters, no item pictures, no numbers, no letters, no Chinese characters, no symbols that resemble text, no embedded buttons, no watermark, no logo; leave the primary content area empty.
Avoid: warm gold dominance, orange, purple neon, modern web dashboard appearance, paper parchment, photorealism, 现代服装，3D CG 渲染感，照片级写实，
网络红人脸，二次元萌系，迪士尼风，
水印，签名，文字乱码，
繁体中文，繁体字，traditional chinese characters，
错字，简化字写错，
整体灰暗，雾蒙蒙，低饱和，沉郁压抑，黯淡无光，灰蒙蒙的色调
